params.prompt: The dancer explodes into motion from this frame — a single powerful spin that starts slow and builds, arms sweeping wide as the body coils and unwinds, coat and hair trailing a half-beat behind. The camera does not sit still: it arcs around her in a fast, low, rising half-circle, swinging from a low angle up toward eye level as she turns, then snaps into a tight tracking push that follows her torso through the second half of the spin. Dust lifts off the ground in the wake of the movement, wind pulls at loose fabric, and a shaft of hard light sweeps across the space as the camera swings, flashing across her face and darkening again. The spin decelerates into a settle — she lands the final turn facing camera, chest rising, one arm extended, dust still hanging in the air.
